Example 1
Observer Name: Ashutosh Sahu

A safety observation was conducted at the Angul unit under the Utility department. The inspection was
carried out in the Conveyor Maintenance Area under the supervision of HOD Rajesh Kumar. The observation
was recorded on 31/05/2026 and the total duration of the inspection was 2 Hours. During the visit, minor oil
leakage was observed near the conveyor gearbox and housekeeping improvements were recommended. The
maintenance team was informed and corrective actions were initiated.
